title: pointLocation
summary: Locate query points in a DelaunayTri triangulation.

gpu_support.notes: `pointLocation` reads host triangulation topology and returns dense host results.

description: `pointLocation(dt, q)` returns the containing triangle index for each query point in a 2-D `DelaunayTri` object. With two outputs, RunMat also returns barycentric coordinates.
behaviors: Accepts query matrices or paired coordinate vectors.
MATLAB-compatible object points, connectivity, and query coordinates use double storage; typed-integer coordinates or connectivity are available in `runmat` compatibility mode.
Returns an N-by-1 tensor of one-based triangle indices.
With two requested outputs, returns `[ti, bc]` where `bc` is N-by-3.
